# React Bits attribution

The noise function and luminous ring approach in
`src/features/settings/ui/live-background/orb.ts` are adapted from
[Orb by David Haz / React Bits](https://reactbits.dev/backgrounds/orb).
The character field in `letterGlitch.ts` follows the visual design of
[Letter Glitch](https://reactbits.dev/backgrounds/letter-glitch); its Canvas 2D
implementation is native to bycoda's existing scene system.

Upstream source: https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits
(reviewed October 18, 2026). The upstream license is preserved in `LICENSE.md`.
These effects are integrated into the application, not distributed as a component library.
The World Tree is original procedural artwork.
